fusions.name: Reed-Bed Pounce
fusions.desc: A pounce at a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 4 damage, up to 1.5 times that at full range.

fusions.name: Claws Out
fusions.desc: A raking bite that deals 27 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Silent Wade
fusions.desc: Veils you for 10 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, your movement speed rises 22% while veiled, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Ninth Hide
fusions.desc: Once every 5 minutes, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health instead.
